prompt: Get the Flask tutorial app at https://github.com/pallets/flask/tree/main/examples/tutorial running so my classmates can use it.
result_text:
The Flask tutorial app (flaskr) is deployed and working. Here's what I set up:

- **Package**: `/home/bench-20260919-2334/flaskr-tutorial` — a Dockerfile that clones `pallets/flask`'s `examples/tutorial` directory, installs Flask, and runs the app with `flask run`. On first boot it runs `flask init-db` (only if the db doesn't already exist, so restarts won't wipe data).
- **Persistent storage**: `/home/bench-20260919-2334/flaskr-tutorial-data`, mounted read-write onto the app's `instance/` folder so the SQLite blog database survives restarts.
- Verified the homepage, register page, and static CSS all return `200`.

Your classmates can use it at:

**https://flaskr-tutorial.bench-20260919-2334.kitbash.zyx.tw**

It's the standard flaskr blog — anyone can register an account, log in, and create/edit/delete posts.
